profileParagraphs: Joel is a senior fullstack developer and software architect with more than 14 years of experience developing and maintaining production systems. He has deep competence in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, React and PostgreSQL, with strong experience in microservice architecture, API design, data modeling and integration-heavy solutions.

He has delivered business-critical systems in banking and payments, e-health, education, culture and startup environments. His work includes payment flows and integrations for Swish at Bankgirot, Java/Spring Boot backends, React interfaces, CI/CD, cloud platforms, production operations and systems with high requirements for security, traceability, uptime, performance and test coverage.

Joel combines a broad technical perspective with pragmatic delivery. He quickly understands complex flows and technical stacks, collaborates closely with product owners and stakeholders, and contributes across architecture, backend, frontend, code review, debugging, quality practices and knowledge sharing.
